parole.testo: From Middle Dutch or Middle Low German tromme, of imitative origin.

parole.significato: the remains of something damaged or worn down to the point of being ruined; a wreck (e.g. a shipwreck)
parole.testo: From Middle Dutch and Middle Low German wrak, probably from Old Saxon *wrak, derived from wrekan. Compare English wrack, German Wrack and Danish vrag.
